finding.title: Delete dead LearningOrderPreferences singleton (superseded by ProfileScopedPreferenceKeys)
finding.rule: dead code + SM-7 (no global/static mutable singletons)
finding.why: This 34-line hand-rolled singleton duplicates the parent-controls-ordering flag that parentControlsOrderingProvider now reads from ProfileScopedPreferenceKeys (learning_order_providers.dart:70-77), a profile-scoped replacement. LearningOrderPreferences is not profile-scoped (one global bool for every profile on the device) and has zero references anywhere in lib/ or test/; if it were wired back in by mistake it would reintroduce both the SM-7 singleton anti-pattern and a cross-profile setting bug.
finding.recommendation: Delete the file now that ProfileScopedPreferenceKeys is the live implementation.
acceptance_criteria: File removed; no dangling references in lib/ or test/

finding.title: De-duplicate the Hebrew-script detection regex in TrackLearningOrderScreen
finding.why: The adjacent comment admits this is a copy of CurriculumLabel's private _hebrew regex (core/labels/curriculum_label.dart:364); the same literal also appears in core/theme/text_styles.dart and core/enums/curriculum_id.dart, for four independent copies repo-wide of one RTL-detection regex. A future Unicode-range fix (e.g. extending to Hebrew presentation forms) has to be found and applied in all four places; missing one silently reintroduces a mis-directioned label in only that spot.
finding.recommendation: Expose CurriculumLabel's Hebrew-detection as a small public helper in core/labels and call it here instead of a private copy.
acceptance_criteria: Only one canonical Hebrew-script RegExp definition remains in core/labels; this screen calls it

finding.title: Extract the repeated reorder-amnesty confirm-dialog preamble in the tracks reorder screens
finding.why: The same ~10-line block (fetch overdueCount, bail if unmounted, show ReorderConfirmDialog.showIfNeeded, bail if declined/unmounted) is copy-pasted 3 times across 2 files. A future change to the amnesty-guard contract has to be found and edited in 3 places; missing one leaves that screen silently skipping the guard.
finding.recommendation: Extract a shared helper (mixin or top-level function taking WidgetRef/BuildContext/CurriculumId) used by all three call sites.
acceptance_criteria: Single shared implementation; all three call sites delegate to it

evidence.quote: 'self-paced Chumash step count is >= 5 (includes all self-paced steps)',

finding.title: Make the TS-10 and TS-2 SelfPacedGoalStep regression tests pump the widget instead of only checking constructor storage

evidence.quote:
test('SelfPacedGoalStep constructor accepts initialGoal', () {
      // If this test compiles, the parameter exists.

test('SelfPacedGoalStep constructor accepts scopeSelections', () {
      // If this test compiles the parameter exists.

finding.why: Both files' docstrings describe real, previously-shipped user-visible bugs (TS-10: Back+Forward through the wizard silently discarded the user's deadline choice; TS-2: the goal step showed the full-curriculum item count instead of the wizard-selected scope). Neither test ever calls tester.pumpWidget — they only construct the widget object and assert the constructor stored the field verbatim, which Dart's own field assignment guarantees trivially. A future refactor that keeps the field but breaks the `initState`/`build` logic that actually consumes it (step_goal.dart:76-88 for TS-10, :351-359 for TS-2) would leave both tests green while silently reintroducing the exact bugs they claim to guard. Confirmed via repo-wide grep: no other test file in the tree pumps SelfPacedGoalStep with a non-null initialGoal or scopeSelections and asserts on the rendered/emitted result.
finding.recommendation: Rewrite both as widget tests: for TS-10, pump SelfPacedGoalStep with initialGoal set to a deadline-type GoalEntity and assert the deadline card renders active (not blurred) and/or that tapping Continue immediately emits goalType=='deadline' with the restored targetDate. For TS-2, pump with non-empty scopeSelections and content items outside the selection, and assert the rendered item-count/estimate reflects only the selected scope, not the full set.
acceptance_criteria: goal_step_ts10_state_preserve_test.dart pumps the widget with a deadline initialGoal and asserts observable deadline-mode state (not just constructor storage) — fails if initState stops reading widget.initialGoal

self_paced_goal_step_scope_test.dart pumps the widget with scopeSelections + a mixed content fixture and asserts the rendered/emitted count is scoped, not the full-curriculum total — fails if the scoping logic regresses
